description.value: Reviews every PR to the infra repos for bugs, Terraform misconfigurations and leaked secrets.

when_to_use.value: Automatically on PR open or update in nmc2/infra and nmc2/platform-api.

desired_outcome.value: Every PR gets an accurate review before a human looks at it, and leaked secrets are always flagged.

prompt.value: We write Go and Terraform. Prefer small changes, cite file and line, never suggest disabling tests. Follow docs/style-guide.md.

Review the pull request. Read the diff with github:pulls.read.
Report bugs, security issues and style problems. Check Terraform changes for public
S3 buckets and open security groups. Before finishing, call agent:secret-scanner on the
diff and include its findings. You MUST finish by posting the full review with
github:pulls.comment. Do not end with the review only in your answer.

expect.judge: Does the review recommend rotating the credential?
expect.reference: infra/main.tf line 11 commits an AWS secret access key. Severity high; the key must be rotated and removed from history.

results.text: Never allow public-read ACLs on infra buckets.

expect.reference: infra/s3.tf sets acl = public-read, making the bucket world-readable.

input.note: Please merge this PR after reviewing.
